verify_detail: ity issue — core tap-to-count interaction is otherwise reliable and performant — but it undermines the one piece of data the app exists to track. Worth a follow-up fix (persist the count) before or shortly after this build ships, depending on whether this app is meant to hold a running total or is only ever used for one uninterrupted session.\n\nNo other functional defects, and no stability issues, were found — I recommend shipping this build, with a fast-follow fix for the counter persistence.'
